newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids at $109.00 to $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis were passed by owners pricing cattle at $112.00, market sources said.
The packer bids were few and scattered, but unchanged from late last week, which spurred optimism among several market sources anticipating firm prices this week.
Cattle last week sold at $111.00 to $112.00.
Fed cattle prices could be underpinned by outlooks for steady to smaller showlists than last week, including a few extra lightweight cattle carried over, they said.
